purpose: Create the minimum retained measurement protocol that could close the candidate-specific kitchen/substitution and optional-rice process evidence gaps without changing source quantities or inventing yield.
preconditions: Use the accepted USSR82-267 column-II + water scope.
Use exact FoodIngredient/form identities approved by later production-data work; if an exact form is unavailable, the execution is invalid rather than substituted silently.
Do not proportionally scale the soup recipe: test the published 1000 g batch.
Record every input and output mass, equipment item and deviation.

soup_branches.branch_step: Blanch turnip for 1–2 minutes before the shared process.

required_measurements_per_soup_branch: Exact measured net input mass for every food and process water.
Start/end timestamps for blanching, sautéing/stewing/pureeing/final heating as actually performed.
Final cooked output mass before serving.
Any discarded/drained mass or unplanned added water; if present, record rather than normalize away.
Observed quality against the retained soup-puree criteria.
retained_quality_criteria: Homogeneous pureed mass without flour lumps or unpureed pieces.
Colour appropriate to the principal vegetable.
Delicate, moderately salted flavour characteristic of the selected vegetable and milk-based soup.

instructions: Use a defined household vessel and record its size/shape.
Record all water actually added; do not force 42 ml if the source-consistent process requires adjustment.
Record whether any water is drained and its mass where measurable.
Record cooking time and whether the rice remains crumbly/free-flowing.
Do not add separate fat: recipe 267 already owns its butter; this test selects the source-compatible plain-rice path.
rice_garnish_test.pass_evidence_needed: A retained measured input/output/process record sufficient to define a versioned 20 g raw-rice → cooked crumbly-rice garnish transformation for the selected vessel/method.

optional_role_check.method: From each verified soup branch, evaluate service both with the separately prepared rice garnish and without it; do not alter the base soup composition.
optional_role_check.goal: Confirm that rice is a true independently optional serving role under the selected recipe-family process rather than a hidden required thickener/component.

pass_requires: Both complete carrot and turnip branches independently satisfy the retained process and quality criteria.
The turnip-only blanching difference is encoded as a branch-specific rule rather than discarded.
No unreviewed ingredients, quantity changes or process repairs are introduced.
The retained record identifies the exact recipe scope, date, executor/reviewer and measured outputs.
substitution_gate_check.meaning_of_pass: Evidence for a curated carrot↔turnip family substitution rule at the tested published batch scope only; no automatic household rescaling.

nutrition_boundary: Kitchen execution may establish process/yield evidence. Nutrient retention remains a separate authority; no hidden 100% retention is inferred.
